profile.summary: Oakland School for the Arts is a school in Oakland, California serving students in grades 6 to 12. It combines core academic classes with specialized arts training in design, visual media arts, and performing arts such as dance, instrumental music, theatre, and vocal music. It is a registered 501(c)(3) tax-exempt educational nonprofit.
